answer: Weight attestations by a memory-bound sweep: each epoch, every identity must present a cipher-bound proof that it sequentially scanned the full append-only event accumulator, and every close adds another ridge of blocks to it. A sybil farm pays fleet size times history size in bandwidth and RAM every epoch, while one honest operator sweeps once and re-signs many proofs. The ivory toll is trivial for one, ruinous for thousands.
